It reads the in-process cache _ML_VOL_PBAR_CACHE published by regime_bar_scoring.emit_regime_bar_predictions; that per-bar scorer builds feature_row_for_predictor(..., forecast_row=compute_live_forecast_row(...)) from live 15m OHLC + the trainer-mirrored fc_* JSON. The inline fallback (_p_volatile_inline) gets candles_df=None on the decision path, so it returns None -> vol 'unknown' -> PERMISSIVE. FINDINGS: (F1) the cache is in-process and empties on every trader restart (5 restarts 21:29-22:38Z tonight); until the next closed 15m bar is scored, every gate decision is 'unknown' (no veto), a coverage gap invisible in the audit because source reads 'ml-advisory:<id>' on both paths and 'unavailable:*' otherwise. (F2) _p_volatile_from_cache never range-checks the bar_ts age (docstring says at most one bar, but a stalled scorer keeps serving the last score). (F3) the inline path, if ever given candles, passes no forecast_row (fc_* NaN) and would score the 15m head on the caller's timeframe. NONE of F1-F3 by itself explains BTC kappa 0.24 on rows that DID carry a label; the remaining suspects are live-vs-offline feature values: (a) fc_* from the trainer-mirror forecasts/<SYM>.json (stale or missing -> NaN), (b) parity OHLC features from live candles vs the offline builder, (c) head identity at decision time vs the head the replay resolves now (advisory swapped 2026-07-20).
